charts.title: Kepler-37 d: orbits around Kepler-37
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-37's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-37 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Holczer et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..225....9H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOLCZER_ET_AL__2016): P 39.79222264 d

charts.title: Kepler-37 d: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-37 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (75, 81, 82) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 164652245, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 18-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
